items.title: What Is Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Signaling With Two Key Trial Wins?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) reported positive Phase 1 results for a dual-antigen immunotherapy in metastatic prostate cancer, including a strong PSA response and clean safety profile. The pasritamig and JNJ-9401 combination is now advancing to Phase 3 testing in men with advanced disease. Separately, oral ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) delivered significant joint and skin symptom improvements in biologic naive psoriatic arthritis patients in a Phase 3 trial. items.title: After the Democratic Midterm Sweep: 4 Dividend Stocks Built for Gridlock
items.summary: When Congress locks up, some dividends barely notice. Four blue chips span power, soap, medicine and banking, and one of them already survived a payout collapse that income investors should not forget before trusting it.

items.title: Benjamin Graham Had a 20-Year Rule for Retirement Income. It Just Won the AI Sell-Off
items.summary: Benjamin Graham's rule for the defensive investor was uninterrupted dividends for at least 20 years. In the month since the S&P 500's record, five holdings that pass it rose 8.8% while the Nasdaq-100 fund fell 13.6%. Here is what that did to a retired couple with $3 million living on $99,265 a year of dividends, and three moves for the week.

items.title: J&J Backs Psychedelic-Inspired Biotech in $100 Million Round
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson is backing a biotech company developing psychedelic-inspired medicines that promise to treat depression without the hallucinations, leading a $100 million financing round as pharmaceutical companies increasingly embrace a once-fringe field.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson’s ICOTYDE Meets Primary Endpoint in Phase 3 Psoriatic Arthritis Trial
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) announced that its investigational treatment ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) achieved the primary endpoint in a Phase 3 clinical trial involving adults with active psoriatic arthritis who had not previously received biologic therapies. The ICONIC-PsA 1 study evaluated the efficacy and safety of ICOTYDE at a dose of 200 mg administered once daily.
